Market today: Yields easing is good for tech. The main driver is anticipation of jobs data and Fed comments, which will dictate future rate expectations. This directly impacts your growth-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-44.23%) and SPAL (-30.62%) are flashing red. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying, and showing deep losses. On margin, these drawdowns are amplified and demand immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on upcoming jobs data and any Fed comments. Also, monitor the 10-year Treasury yield for continued easing or reversal.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively; market sentiment for tech hinges on macro data this week.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given the -44.23% loss and "SELL" status. Leveraged ETFs decay, and margin amplifies this pain.
SPAL: Review SPAL with its -30.62% loss and "SELL" status. Similar to SOXL, its leveraged nature and decay make it a high-risk holding on margin.
GOOGL: If looking to add, scanner shows ACCUMULATE 9/12. Entry 354.62-354.26, stop 353.47. This aligns with easing yields.
